ace.definition: combined - reset - compact + baseline; per cell
ace.interpretation: Negative cost indicates additional saving beyond additive effects; positive coverage indicates additional coverage.

agentic.definition: combined - reset - compact + baseline; per cell
agentic.interpretation: Negative cost indicates additional saving beyond additive effects; positive coverage indicates additional coverage.

operational_sensitivity.primary: All registered cells, including the provider failure and all continuation charges
operational_sensitivity.reason: One provider rejection and two administrative continuations in the same theorem family. This sensitivity was specified before resumption or later validation results.

uncertainty: Reused development partitions; repeated seeds are clustered by theorem family. Exploratory comparisons are not multiplicity-adjusted. Frontier selection and uncached repricing are descriptive, not new experiments. No equivalence claim follows from equal counts.
